## Changes since v1.0.1

- Fixed the Faction Select Name Randomizer button layout while preserving the full name field.
- Aligned the money row beneath the name and widened the button to fit its label.
- Confirmed the updated layout works in-game with vanilla Anomaly 1.5.3 and SOTA UI.
- Standardized mod version labels to four numeric parts across READMEs, metadata, and packaging checks.
- Updated documentation, installation instructions, and file-conflict guidance across the collection.

## Installation

Download the ZIPs for the mods you want and install them separately in Mod Organizer 2. Check each mod’s README for requirements and compatibility details.
